patch.value: GH-889: merge-conflict recovery guidance hides the durable discarded-value report

GitHub issue #889 proves that the field-aware merge driver tells agents to re-apply a losing change but does not name pm merge report, the only durable surface containing base, ours, theirs, retained, and discarded values. The working item contains only the retained side, so the prescribed recovery is impossible from the refusal context.

Every conflict guidance envelope points directly to pm merge report and a stable receipt or item correlation key; CLI, SDK, help, docs, and tests prove an agent can recover discarded values using only the emitted recovery bundle; Multi-item and multi-conflict fixtures prove the guidance is unambiguous without leaking private content into generic logs
pm-cli 2026.8.3 field-aware merge driver in a two-branch same-field conflict
Create divergent title and priority mutations on two branches, merge them with the configured pm driver, and read the emitted guidance before separately running pm merge report
Conflict guidance names the exact report command and receipt identity required to recover every discarded value
Guidance says to re-apply the losing change without exposing or pointing to the losing value
Resolving agents silently discard valid concurrent work or spelunk Git history outside the structured PM workflow
